_readme: THE OWNER'S CONSENT, AND NOTHING ELSE DECIDES IT.
DEFROST.WORLD reads this app every day. These two flags are the only thing
that lets it take anything. Darren owns them: change a true to a false here,
push, and the next build writes an empty pack. Nothing else in the code may
override them, and no script may set them to true on its own.
defrostFeed      — may DEFROST show this site's social posts in its feed?
defrostKnowledge — may DEFROST read this site's own public pages, so its
Oracle can answer questions about RAW and link back here?
Nothing private is ever included either way. See DEFROST-INTEGRATION.md,
section 10, for the exact list of what goes in and what never does.
